patch_description: This crossover ansatz keeps the parameter budget at the strong 146-parameter regime while mixing the best parts of the prior candidates: the expressive RX+RY single-qubit preprocessing from the current program, the CZ chain structure from the seed, and a small set of long-range CRZ bridges to capture nonlocal correlations. To reduce overfitting and improve validation/test generalization, the RZ phase layer uses shared parameters across paired wires, giving a compact but structured block that should train faster and generalize better under the fixed Adam loop.
